summary: Operator site: full hookups 20/30/50 A on 65 x 45 ft lots, from $45 a night, $225 a week (under the $50 gate); online request/phone booking with prepayment. No membership: nights are sold to anyone; only monthly stays need approval. Long-stay five tests pass (nightly rate + phone on its own site, no minimum, no lease/application for nights, not a home community; no site count published, RV Life lists 34). No gateway within 40 km (not needed at $45). Pin matches Google. Note trimmed of hookups/lot size/rate; the derived pull_through (not stated anywhere on the operator's site) is left untouched.
